questions.text: Describe a goal that you would like to achieve in the future.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a goal that you would like to achieve in the future. You should say: what the goal is; when you would like to achieve it; what you need to do to achieve it; and explain why this goal is important to you.

questions.text: Have you told other people about this goal?
questions.say: Thank you. Have you told other people about this goal?

questions.text: Do you think young people today are more ambitious than their parents were?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a goal you would like to achieve, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all ambition. Do you think young people today are more ambitious than their parents were?

questions.text: Is it always a good thing to be very ambitious?
questions.say: Is it always a good thing to be very ambitious?

questions.text: Should parents encourage their children to set goals?

questions.text: How do people in your country usually measure success?

questions.text: Is it possible to be successful without hard work?
questions.say: Is it possible to be successful without hard work?

questions.text: Why do some famous people find success difficult to deal with?
